mechanismOfAction.summary: Presumed NMDA receptor antagonist; 2-oxo-arylcyclohexylamine (methoxetamine/MXiPr relative with 2-fluoro substituent replacing 2-methoxy of MXE).
mechanismOfAction.description: Tentative IUPAC: 2-(2-fluorophenyl)-2-(isopropylamino)cyclohexan-1-one. The ortho-fluoro isomer replaces the methoxy group of MXE's pharmacophore. NMR-confirmed as ortho-F isomer. Sibling: 2-FXPr (n-propyl variant). Only a single anecdotal intranasal report exists (nervewing blog, 2025) — not a validated dose source; rapid tolerance noted in that report. No CAS/CID available.
